notes.title: Demonic Supremacy is out now!
notes.content:
It is my pleasure to welcome you to the expanse of hellfire!  Get ready to experience the ultimate adrenaline rush with Demonic Supremacy, the retro shooter that will blow your hats off. Where to kill all the creatures of hell, is the only true way!

[previewyoutube=BCZE2mFWTFo;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Epic and memorable protagonist Zexus
[*] 90’s-style graphics
[*] Mighty bosses including the Lord of Hell himself
[*] Old-school FPS gameplay
[*] HEAVY METAL, BABY!
[/list]
This is just a small list of what you'll get in this hellish adventure. 
Many thanks and have a great game,
ChiliDog Interactive

P.S. The game is not adapted for ultrawidescreen resolutions.
The problem with fast cursor (camera speed) has been fixed.

notes.title: Demonic Supremacy on Steam Next Fest 2023 June edition
notes.content:
Attention all demon hunters! Get ready to experience the ultimate adrenaline rush with Demonic Supremacy, the retro shooter that will blow your hats off! Join me for an exclusive one-hour long stream on Steam. All viewers can expect varied gameplay demonstration showing the best parts of the game. 

Starting from June 19 you'll be able to enjoy the game first-handed by playing the Steam demo available during the Steam Next Fest! With splendid graphics and immersive gameplay, Demonic Supremacy is the best possible choice for anyone who loves fast-paced action, big guns and old-school vibes. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of FPS games, you won't be able to put this game down. 

So mark your calendars and join the exclusive stream of Demonic Supremacy. And don't miss out on this gaming experience – June 19 is the date to try the Demonic Supremacy demo yourself!

See you there,
ChiliDog Interactive
